verdict.rationale: Firebase exposes well-documented CLI (firebase-tools) and SDKs (Auth, Firestore, Functions, Realtime DB) that let developers programmatically manage projects, data, and functions, plus an official MCP server for AI tooling integration (Antigravity, Claude, Cursor, etc.) that can create projects, manage Auth users, and query Firestore. However, no formal OpenAPI/REST spec is publicly discoverable (probe shows 404s for openapi.json/swagger.json), so an AI agent must rely on SDK/CLI/MCP wrappers rather than a raw REST API. missing for 10: a published OpenAPI/REST specification and independent hands-on verification of the MCP server's reliability.
